verdict.rationale: Crossmint's docs consistently frame everything (wallets, agent cards, checkouts, onramp/offramp) as API-first with headless/full-control options (crossmint-docs-7, crossmint-docs-26, crossmint-docs-19) and even an embedded iframe alternative (crossmint-docs-8) implying UI features are optional wrappers over the same API. However, there's no explicit statement or audit confirming full UI/API parity, and the openapi.json probe returned 404 across all standard paths, suggesting no discoverable machine-readable API spec despite an interactive API reference existing. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or audit showing every UI-exposed action (e.g., dashboard-only settings) has an API equivalent, and a working OpenAPI/machine-readable spec for API-native tooling.
